scheme_name: SIDBI Make in India Soft Loan Fund (SMILE)
overview: SIDBI Make in India Soft Loan Fund for Enterprises (SMILE) is a soft loan scheme by the Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) aimed at providing financial assistance to MSMEs and service enterprises for setting up new projects, expansion, modernization, diversification, technology upgradation, and rehabilitation of sick units. The scheme supports both manufacturing and service sectors, with a focus on promoting Make in India initiatives by facilitating access to affordable credit for capital investment and operational needs.
objectives: Provide soft loans for setting up new projects in manufacturing and service sectors
Support expansion, modernization, diversification, and technology upgradation of existing units
Promote Make in India initiative by enhancing domestic manufacturing capabilities
Provide financial assistance for capital investment and operational needs of MSMEs
Encourage technology adoption and industrial upgradation
Support service sector enterprises for service expansion and quality improvement
eligibility: The scheme is open to MSMEs and service enterprises engaged in manufacturing or service activities. Eligible entities include sole proprietorships, partnerships, cooperative societies, private and public limited companies in the micro and small sector. Units undertaking new projects, expansion, modernization, diversification, technology upgradation, or rehabilitation of sick units are eligible. Priority may be given to women entrepreneurs and units adopting state-of-the-art technology.
benefits: The scheme provides soft loans with favorable terms including concessional interest rates, extended repayment tenors, and flexible repayment options. It supports capital expenditure for plant and machinery, technical know-how, and other project-related expenses. The loan is designed to reduce the financial burden on enterprises undertaking long gestation projects and promotes technology upgradation and modernization. Additional benefits may include collateral relaxation and simplified documentation for eligible borrowers.
financial_support: SMILE provides soft loans for project financing, covering expenses related to plant and machinery, technical know-how, and other project components. The loan amount is need-based and subject to the project cost and borrower's repayment capacity. Repayment tenure is structured to align with project cash flows, often including a moratorium period. Interest rates are concessional compared to market rates, and the loan may be covered under credit guarantee schemes like CGTMSE to reduce collateral requirements.
application_process: 1. Identify the project requirement and prepare a detailed project report including project cost, means of financing, and projected financials. 2. Approach the nearest SIDBI branch or office with the project proposal and required documents. 3. Submit the loan application along with the project report and supporting documents. 4. SIDBI officials will conduct due diligence, including technical and financial appraisal of the project. 5. Upon approval, a sanction letter is issued outlining the loan amount, interest rate, repayment schedule, and other terms. 6. Complete documentation and execution of loan agreement. 7. Disbursement of loan amount in stages as per project progress and submission of utilization certificates.
required_documents: Project report detailing project cost, means of financing, and projected financials
Proof of identity and address of the promoter(s)
Proof of business constitution (Partnership deed, Certificate of Incorporation, etc.)
Land documents (ownership/lease agreement) and building plans
Quotations for plant and machinery and other assets
Sanction letters from other lenders (if any)
Income tax returns and audited financial statements for existing businesses
Project approvals and NOCs from relevant authorities (if applicable)
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year based on fund availability and project viability.
implementing_agency: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
contact_details: Toll Free Number: 180-022-6753 | Phone: +91 86930 33333 | Email: Available via SIDBI's online enquiry form at https://sidbi.in/online-enquiry
caveats: Loan approval is subject to credit appraisal, project viability, and availability of funds under the scheme
The loan must be utilized strictly for the purpose specified in the sanction letter
Beneficiaries must comply with all terms and conditions of the loan agreement, including timely repayment
Submission of utilization certificates and progress reports may be required during the loan tenure
The scheme may be subject to periodic review and revision by SIDBI based on policy changes
